hyperedges.label: ApplyBatch transactional safety (backup, journal, ledger, rollback, recovery)

nodes.label: ITweakCatalog
nodes.rationale: Engine knows the catalog only via this interface, decoupling Engine from Catalog.

nodes.label: TweakPilot.Catalog
nodes.rationale: Embedded tweak JSONs, schema, language files, loader with schema validation and linter.

nodes.label: TweakPilot.Cli (tweakpilot-cli.exe)
nodes.rationale: asInvoker test console and later command line.

nodes.label: TweakPilot.Core
nodes.rationale: net8.0 with no Windows APIs: tweak model, actions, detection conditions, interfaces, error types, version check, command whitelist, registry allowlist.

nodes.label: TweakPilot.Engine
nodes.rationale: net8.0-windows: executors per action type, state detection, transactions, backup sets, journal, ledger. UI and helper share the same engine; no second code path.

nodes.label: FluentAssertions 6.12.2 (Apache-2.0, test only)
nodes.rationale: Version 8+ has a commercial license, so v6 is used.

nodes.label: JsonSchema.Net 7.3.4 (MIT)
nodes.rationale: Validates tweak JSON files against the schema; shipped with the app, no telemetry.

nodes.label: System.ServiceProcess.ServiceController 8.0.1 (MIT)
nodes.rationale: Used for Windows service control.

nodes.label: Pin FluentAssertions to 6.12.x
nodes.rationale: v8+ has commercial license.

nodes.label: No Moq: own Fake implementations
nodes.rationale: Executors tested against tests/TweakPilot.Engine.Tests/Fakes.cs; unused dependency would violate quality gate.

nodes.label: One state store per batch (User vs Machine)
nodes.norm_label: one state store per batch (user vs machine)
nodes.rationale: Mixed batches rejected by CLI in Phase 1; helper takes machine tweaks from Phase 2.

nodes.label: Legacy script FortniteOptimizer.ps1
nodes.rationale: Left unchanged; has active backup, uses -ExecutionPolicy Bypass (forbidden in TweakPilot), sets MMCSS values (rejected), IFEO CPU priority (GAME-016), unsafe temp deletion (CLEAN-001/002).

nodes.label: Mass service disabling from forum lists (rejected)
nodes.norm_label: mass service disabling from forum lists (rejected)

nodes.label: MMCSS values as 'FPS boost' (rejected)
nodes.rationale: No proven effect; set by legacy script, not adopted.

nodes.label: Registry cleaner (rejected)
nodes.rationale: No measurable gain, stability risk.

nodes.label: Manual WinSxS deletion (rejected, use DISM CLEAN-014)
nodes.norm_label: manual winsxs deletion (rejected, use dism clean-014)

nodes.label: PERF-001 High Performance Power Plan
nodes.rationale: powercfg /setactive SCHEME_MIN; read-only host check to avoid touching legacy script's saved power state; Umstritten.

nodes.label: PERF-016 Disable Fax Service
nodes.rationale: Fax service not installed on dev machine; reports unavailable (rule S12); only tested against fakes; Umstritten.

nodes.label: Rejected Tweaks
nodes.rationale: IDs are never reused.

nodes.label: Performance tweaks without measurement are 'Umstritten'
nodes.rationale: Honest impact claims; hidden by default until Phase 6 measurement.

nodes.label: Write-Ahead Journal (journal.json)
nodes.rationale: States Pending, Applying, Applied, RolledBack, RollbackFailed, Committed enable crash recovery.

nodes.label: Ledger (ledger.json)
nodes.rationale: Records applied tweaks; used for conflict checks against already-applied tweaks.

nodes.label: RecoverInterrupted / GetInterruptedBatches
nodes.rationale: On start, open batches are restored from the backup set after checksum verification.

nodes.label: DeferredRestorePointService
nodes.rationale: No restore points in Phase 1; engine always asks, CLI requires --no-restore-point; own backup always created.

nodes.label: ApplyBatch flow
nodes.rationale: Plan -> preview (Describe, read-only) -> restore point -> Capture/backup -> per-tweak Apply+Verify -> rollback on error -> Committed. If backup fails nothing is changed.

nodes.label: Atomic state file writes
nodes.rationale: Temp file then replace; corrupted files are reported, never silently reset.

nodes.label: Rollback from backed-up originals
nodes.rationale: All begun actions rolled back in reverse order and verified against original state.

nodes.label: Batch rollback always uses backed-up originals
nodes.norm_label: batch rollback always uses backed-up originals
nodes.rationale: Explicit counter-actions only for single-tweak reset without conflict with 'keep current value'.

nodes.label: Color Palette & Tokens (Dark/Light)
nodes.rationale: Tokens only via resource keys, never hex in XAML; dark is default.

nodes.label: WPF with WPF-UI instead of WinUI 3
nodes.norm_label: wpf with wpf-ui instead of winui 3

nodes.label: WCAG 4.5:1 contrast adjustment
nodes.rationale: Three light-palette colors darkened minimally to reach 4.5:1; dark accent button uses Background-colored text.

nodes.label: Open point: VM test matrix
nodes.rationale: Home edition dev machine lacks Hyper-V/Sandbox; only HKCU tweaks tested on host.

nodes.label: UI-001 Classic Context Menu
nodes.rationale: Creates CLSID {86ca1aa0-...}\InprocServer32; visible effect after Explorer restart unverified, so Umstritten.

nodes.label: Tweak Authoring Guide
nodes.rationale: Tweaks are data; new tweaks need no code change if using existing action types.

nodes.label: Command Whitelist
nodes.rationale: Program always from system dir, args as list, single placeholder only with allowed values, no shell.

nodes.label: Registry Key Allowlist (RegistryPaths.KeyAllowlist)
nodes.rationale: Key creation/deletion only below allowlist; checked in linter and at runtime.

nodes.label: Tweak success rule (S13): verify + detection Applied
nodes.norm_label: tweak success rule (s13): verify + detection applied
nodes.rationale: Success only when every action re-read and confirmed its value and state detection reports Applied; otherwise rollback.

nodes.label: detect/apply symmetry rule
nodes.rationale: Each apply action has exactly one matching detect condition with same target value and vice versa; checked by linter.

nodes.label: Catalog linter rules
nodes.rationale: ID format MODUL-NNN, i18n keys in both languages, >=1 source, Umstritten hidden by default, Placebo never shipped, HKCU=User scope no admin, HKLM/services/power/commands=Machine+admin, path rules, allowlist, whitelist.

nodes.label: PRIV-001 Disable Advertising ID
nodes.rationale: HKCU AdvertisingInfo\Enabled=0; verified 2026-10-17 on build 26200, passed.

nodes.label: PRIV-013 Disable Feedback Prompts
nodes.rationale: Siuf\Rules PeriodInNanoSeconds and NumberOfSIUFInPeriod = 0; passed.

nodes.label: Microsoft Learn: Manage connections from Windows OS components to Microsoft services
nodes.norm_label: microsoft learn: manage connections from windows os components to microsoft services

nodes.label: Extended detect conditions (RegistryValueAbsent, RegistryKeyAbsent, CommandQueryEquals, AllOf)
nodes.norm_label: extended detect conditions (registryvalueabsent, registrykeyabsent, commandqueryequals, allof)
nodes.rationale: Without them delete actions, commands and multi-value tweaks (PRIV-013) could not be verified against apply.

nodes.label: 'Mehr Details' side panel
nodes.rationale: Shows description, side effects, technical details, sources, reset button.

nodes.label: Risk and Impact Badges
nodes.rationale: Risk: Sicher/Vorsicht/Experte; Impact: Belegt/Gering/Umstritten. Always text plus symbol, color never sole cue.

nodes.label: Language files de-DE.json / en-US.json
nodes.rationale: Side-effect text (.side) is never empty.

nodes.label: Design Do's and Don'ts (no scare tactics, no fake progress)
nodes.norm_label: design do's and don'ts (no scare tactics, no fake progress)
nodes.rationale: Honest badges, always show side effects, always offer preview, no fear wording, no percent promises, no emojis.

hyperedges.label: ApplyBatch transactional safety (backup, journal, ledger, rollback, recovery)
